version.changelog: Add bilingual (English + Chinese) content for SKILL.md and README.md

llm.summary: This is a transparent writing-analysis skill that guides a user through creating a local style-reference SKILL.md, with no hidden execution or data movement found.

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown-only and does not request shell commands, network access, broad filesystem access, or external services.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The README tells users to place the generated output under a local skills directory, but this is explicit, user-directed, and expected for the purpose.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to literary/style distillation and include user confirmation gates; no prompt override, tool hijacking, credential use, or unrelated authority is requested.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The only persistence-like behavior is the disclosed creation of a reusable local SKILL.md by the user; no automatic background process, startup hook, cron job, or cross-session backdoor is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, inputs, and behavior align: it asks for user-provided writing samples and context, runs a structured analysis, requires checkpoints, and outputs a writing-style skill template.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review any generated author-specific SKILL.md before loading it locally, especially if it includes private writing samples, organizational voice guidance, or copyrighted source material. The reviewed package itself is Markdown-only and does not perform automatic installation or execution.
llm.findings:
[RA2] unexpected: The cited text describes a test-driven writing-quality pass, not unauthorized session persistence; artifact inspection found no cron jobs, startup scripts, state files, or executable persistence mechanism.
[SQP-2] expected: The local skills-directory instruction is real, but it is clearly disclosed as the intended output/install step for a generated skill and remains under user control.
[SQP-3] expected: The bilingual English/Chinese presentation is a localization/design choice, not a security concern or hidden behavior.
